brief_items.question: Work Summary
brief_items.problem: Expected "I'm an undergraduate at Johns Hopkins studying Applied Mathematics & Statistics and Economics, class of 2029, and most of my work sits between software engineering, machine learning, and product. Right now I build the machine-learning core of an anomaly-detection and alert-prioritization system at Summer Atlantic Capital / SAC Nexus, where I own the event-ingestion pipeline, a versioned FastAPI detection service, temporal sequence models over event streams, a learning-to-rank layer for alerts, and a retrieval-augmented explanation layer so analysts can act on the output. Before that I worked with Intelehealth on AI and data systems for rural telemedicine, including a resource-availability scoring pipeline across 32 villages and an evaluation framework comparing LLM-generated clinical outputs against a 4,169-case standard. I co-founded Open Health Intelligence and am technical lead for ClarityAtlas, an iOS app I built in Swift/SwiftUI with Supabase and HealthKit, including passive sleep estimation without a wearable, shipped into a live Hopkins pilot with 30+ users. I've also served as lead model developer on a Gates Foundation-funded health equity project using XGBoost and G-formula simulations on roughly 10 million records."; page shows "(empty)"
